page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 compute-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is absent, with the GPU count set to zero.

The server contains no local storage, requiring persistent data and operating system installations to rely on network-attached block storage. Network throughput is backed by a 10 Gbps baseline interface, and the configuration does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating configured network routing or attached elastic IPs for external network access.

The high memory capacity relative to compute cores provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound systems that do not need heavy graphics acceleration or local disk pools. Tradeoffs include the dependency on remote storage latency and throughput limits over the 10 Gbps interface. The ecs.r6.8xlarge instance is configured to support large-scale in-memory databases, distributed memory caches, real-time data streaming analytics, and enterprise data processing pipelines.
